## About
Johnson's Auto Repair goes back to Roy Johnson, a WWII veteran who opened McHale's Full Service Gas Station in the U-District, where Tully's Coffee and Burgermaster stand today. Roy built his business on being fair and honest, and on customer trust.
His son Jeff started working at the station, studied repair and maintenance at the Arizona Automotive Institute, and came home to take over. He moved the shop to Wedgwood, focused it on full service repair, and gave it the name Johnson's Auto Repair. Today Jeff works alongside managers Lou Kennedy and Igor Levin and technicians Christian Learned and RJ Johnson, Jeff's son.
Customers have mostly found us by referral. Ask around. Chances are one of your neighbors is already a customer.

## Services
- Brakes: From squeaky brakes to new pads and rotors.
- Buyer, pre-trip, & safety inspections: A careful look before you buy a car or head out on a trip.
- Computer diagnostics: Check engine light on? We'll find out why.
- Cooling systems: Radiators, water pumps and the rest of the cooling system.
- Complete electrical systems: Alternators, batteries, lighting, starters, windows, wiring and more.
- Front and rear suspension & shocks: Suspension and shock work, front and back.
- Heating & air conditioning: Heat for Seattle winters and cool air when you need it.
- Oil change & tune ups: The regular care that keeps your car running right.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Thursday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where are you?
A: 9418 35th Avenue NE, Seattle, WA 98115, in Wedgwood. Call (206) 522-3305.

Q: Will you tell me what needs fixing first?
A: One reviewer said they got a free estimate and were told what to fix first for safety reasons.

Q: I heard the shop is changing. What's happening?
A: Johnson's Auto Repair may be closing. Jeff's son RJ is continuing the Johnson service across the street at his own shop, Guards Rad Garage, in the Spirit Gas Station location.
